hotelDescription:
Welcome to Frankfurt and our smart new hotel. If you’re staying at Premier Inn Frankfurt Messe, you’ve chosen a great spot, with the Messe exhibition ground, Festhalle concert hall and Kap Europa congress centre all on your doorstep. Just a short bus or train ride away, you’ll find Frankfurt’s main station and sights of the city, like the beautiful Römerberg Square, Paul‘s Church and Zeil shopping mile. So, whether it’s a business trip or city break, you’re in the right place.

This brand new Premier Inn features our most modern rooms, each with luxury super comfy beds for an unbeatable night‘s sleep. There’s also plenty of desk space for you to work and seating to relax. Our restaurant serves a delicious breakfast buffet and tasty dinners, while our Costa Coffee offers hot drinks and hearty snacks throughout the day.
hotelDirections:
By car: Take the A648 at Westkreuz Frankfurt and follow signs to Stadtmitte (City Centre). The motorway merges into the B44. Follow the B44 to Stadtmitte, passing the Festhalle concert hall and Messeturm building on your right. After 600 metres, turn right onto Mainzer Landstraße (signposted Höchst). After 400 metres, turn right onto Güterplatz (signposted Messe). At the first traffic lights, turn left into Europa-Allee (signposted Europaviertel). Continue straight for 600 metres. The hotel and car park will be on your right. Please note that we’re situated in Frankfurt‘s low emission zone, which you can only enter if your car has a green emmisions sticker.

By train or bus: We’re just a few minutes from Hauptbahnhof, Frankfurt‘s main station. Take underground line U4 to Festhalle/Messe or overground lines S3, S4, S5 or S6 to Messe. Both stops are less than 800 metres from the hotel. Or take bus 46 to Den Haager Straße (approx 7 minutes), which is 200 metres from the hotel. The bus runs every 20 to 30 minutes, seven days a week.
parkingDescription: Our underground car park has 60 chargeable parking spaces. These are assigned on a ‘first come first served‘ basis and can‘t be reserved. You’ll find more parking options at Skyline Plaza and Messeturm car parks, just a short walk away.

restaurant.description: A good breakfast or a hearty dinner is one of the best things in life. That’s why we’ve laid on a seriously tasty breakfast buffet and a delicious dinner menu at our Premier Inn Frankfurt Messe. And if you’re craving a hot drink or a little treat during the day, you’ll find our Costa Shop next door.

menus.name: Breakfast
menus.description:
Start your day the right way – choose as much as you like from our tempting Premier Inn Breakfast Buffet. And don’t forget – kids eat breakfast for free*!

* Up to two under-16s eat breakfast free when one adult orders a full Premier Inn Breakfast Buffet.

menus.name: Dinner
menus.description:
Joining us for dinner?

At Lounge* we have all your favourites from savoury nachos and tarte flambée to crispy salads and pasta, you will find delicious treats for big and small appetites. If you like culinary classics you will enjoy our sophisticated burgers with French fries. Round off this tasty experience with a hot apple strudel or warm brownie for dessert.

We serve up our delicious Costa Coffee and a selection of teas and regional non-alcoholic and alcoholic beverages such as the popular Frankfurt cider or a variety of international beverage specialities.
